dependency.status: Reviewed unmerged Grade1 proposal inherited by normal merges, including the documentation-only historical-checkpoint correction. Data remain exact to b4102bc. Retarget/reconcile to main after base acceptance; no accepted-main/DB publication claim.

reuseDecision: Reuse the exact full claim approved in the Grade1 cultural-renewal proposal; no new or reshaped cultural claim. The primary7–8 context supports the complete disruption/renewal/identity operation, not only one word or case.

assessmentProtocol.materials: Use the exact inherited attributed case summaries and age-appropriate non-graphic NCTR historical context; no primary-pupil visit to adult historical material, enrolment or target-language performance is required.
assessmentProtocol.task: Identify what practices/teachings are being strengthened, who leads the particular initiative, and its relation to historical colonial disruption and present cultural/identity connections. Use another attributed case for transfer, distinguishing each people/community/organization. For A1, combine this with the actual own-family and local-group tradition comparisons and their supported causes; the renewal card alone is not the whole diverse-group comparison.
assessmentProtocol.positive: Explains a supported historical-disruption→community-agency→renewal/identity relationship and identifies a particular way cultural knowledge/practices are reclaimed; transfers without generalizing one programme to all peoples.
assessmentProtocol.nearMiss: Only names a people, says respect everyone, treats cultures as gone, labels every tradition colonial recovery, or confuses learning ABOUT a language initiative with speaking that language.
assessmentProtocol.transfer: Another of the exact inherited authoritative cases; retain its different organization, language/community and documented scope.
assessmentProtocol.scopeLimits: Source examples do not require all ceremonies/practices, protected performance, family testimony or a classroom outcome study. The excluded optional Native Languages programme remains excluded; mandatory Indigenous history/culture here remains in scope.
assessmentProtocol.inheritanceLimit: NCTR supports general historical context; do not claim every named individual/programme has the same local residential-school history or guaranteed outcome.
